description.value: Pho Capital is a cozy Vietnamese restaurant in Richmond that has been serving slow-simmered pho, bánh mì sandwiches, and fresh vermicelli bowls since 2022. The kitchen starts early each day to simmer broth and prep fresh herbs, with a broad menu spanning beef soups, grilled meats, salad rolls, and a range of appetizers. It is a welcoming sit-down spot well suited to a mid-ride meal, with complimentary Wi-Fi and online ordering available.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 55m; rack at 60m; rack at 60m; rack at 70m; rack at 81m; rack at 92m; rack at 96m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully live and corroborates all OSM contact fields: same phone, same address (130-5508 Hollybridge Way, Richmond, BC V7C 0C7), same URL. The website explicitly advertises 'complimentary Wi-Fi,' an 'ORDER HERE' button indicating takeout/online ordering, and the menu lists multiple vegetarian items (vegetarian bánh mì, vegetarian salad rolls). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill anywhere in the website text.
concerns: Website footer on the front page incorrectly reads 'Richmond, United States' instead of 'Richmond, Canada' — minor website error, does not affect the physical location.
Hours discrepancy within the website: the contact subpage lists Monday–Saturday only, while other pages list Monday–Sunday. Not material to directory listing but may confuse visitors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Vietnamese restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and recent OSM check date of 2026-03-02. Useful refueling stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also lists an email address: info@phocapitalrichmond.com (not present in OSM tags).

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists vegetarian bánh mì (fried tofu and vegetarian ham), vegetarian salad rolls (Gỏi cuốn chay), and fried tofu as standalone items

price.signal: Pho mains $17.95–$24.95; sit-down Vietnamese noodle house, not counter-service
